Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

sound verb

make a sound

also make a sound, resound, ring out, mean (of a word)

classical

Cic. Rep. 6.18: ut extrēma ex alterā parte graviter, ex alterā autem acūtē sonent (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Fin. 2.6: quid sonet haec vōx voluptātis (Lewis & Short)

sonō, sonāre, sonuī, sonitum

verb, first conjugation

make a sound, sound, resound; utter; of a word, mean

Examples

  • redde pilam: sonat aes thermārum. lūdere pergis?

    give back the ball: the bell of the baths is ringing. Are you still playing?Mart. 14.163.1

  • quid sonet haec vōx voluptātis

    what this word “pleasure” meansCic. Fin. 2.6 (Lewis & Short)

See also noise, echo.
